remarks: An elegantly renovated 1,680 square foot 3 bedroom, 3 bath corner unit in a desirable hi rise building located in a convenient walk to town location. Common charges include heat, hot water, city water, city sewer, reserved parking and all building amenities including secure front desk reception and live in super. Sparkling newer kitchen. Open and airy living and dining spaces are fresh and appealing and enjoy a screened balcony overlooking the sights and sounds of a bustling city. Primary bedroom with newer full bath, large walk in closet, additional double closet and screened balcony. Secure storage in the lower level of the building. Comfortable in town living with a CT Transit stop at the front door.
